acceptance_criteria.statement: An agent can mark a Task done through a CLI command.
An agent can update a Plan's content through the CLI as it works, and validation still applies to what it writes.

content.statement: As a developer, I can have the agents doing the work mark Tasks done and update the Plan, so the Plan stays accurate without someone maintaining it by hand.
content.title: Let agents keep the Plan current as they work

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. An agent marks Tasks done and writes a Plan's content through the CLI, with validation applying.
